description: Permanently delete a note. Removes the file from disk AND its index rows (edges, embedding, node). Requires `confirm: true` to guard against accidents. When the delete removes inbound edges, the response is wrapped in a next_actions envelope suggesting a follow-up `rank_notes(method=pagerank, minIncomingLinks=0)` to spot newly orphaned notes.

confirm.description: Must literally be `true` to execute. Guards against accidental deletion.

dryRun.description: If true, report what would be deleted without removing any files.

name.description: Path or fuzzy match of the note to delete.

name: delete_note
